anyOf.description: A canonical-event.schema.json member a column can fill. metadata takes any number of columns (at most 64), each under its source column's name; every other field takes at most one.

transform.description: D-009 / D-070: how a source value becomes the field's value; never an expression, script or code. identity: the text as it is (a JSON events value: a string, or a number's literal as written; any JSON value for metadata). rfc3339: an RFC 3339 date-time with an offset (Z or ±hh:mm), kept as written; no time zone is ever assumed. integer_ms: a whole number of milliseconds written in JSON's integer grammar without a sign (0 to 9007199254740991). boolean_literal: true or false (ASCII letters in any case, or a JSON boolean). An empty value (an empty CSV field, a JSON null, an empty string or a missing member) leaves the field out.
